lines.text: Israel forgot the LORD and served the Baals and Asherahs, so He sold them to Cushan-rishathaim for seven years.
The LORD raised up Othniel, the Spirit came upon him, he prevailed in war, and the land rested forty years.
Eglon of Moab, joined by the Ammonites and Amalekites, defeated Israel and ruled eighteen years until Ehud became deliverer.
Ehud strapped a double-edged sword to his left thigh under his cloak and plunged it into Eglon's belly.
Ehud escaped to Seirah and blew the ram's horn, and Israel struck down ten thousand Moabites at the Jordan fords.
